title: Chapter 946
text:
The dark earth stretched as far as the eye could see. Everywhere he looked, there were craters all over the earth. Occasionally, half of a metal wreckage would pop out from the earth. He could not tell what it was originally a part of. In the distance, there was a protruding black peak that gave off a desolate and ancient aura.

The sky was gray, and the stars were sparse. The sun was dim, and a strong wind blew. Countless fine sand was swept up in the wind, and the strong wind pulled everything on the surface.

This was a black, desolate planet. It was wrapped in a thick layer of gray haze and filled with an atmosphere. Looking down from outer space, one could see the storm-like cyclones in the planet's atmosphere.

In the past, this was a planet full of life. Green and red could be seen everywhere, and the roars of wild beasts could be heard throughout the mountains and forests. Now, there was only a black silence. This was an ancient battlefield in the dynasty.

Below the ground, there were a large number of battleships and weapon wreckages. Now, the wind and sand had buried the past, leaving only desolation.

A black figure walked slowly on the ground, as if it was one with the black background of the ground.

"This is fine."

Han Xiao looked up at the gray sky and knew that the spaceship was waiting for him in outer space. The people on the spaceship were most likely looking at him through the observation window.

The commotion caused by the Beyond Grade A Promotion would not be small, not to mention that this time, it was the Species Sublimation and the Main Class Promotion together. It would probably shake the earth and mountains. He was afraid that he would crash during the Promotion on the spaceship, so Han Xiao found a relatively nearby uninhabited planet and prepared to complete his level 300 Promotion there.

Of course, he had already touched Fu Ding before coming, so he was full of confidence at this time.

Opening the interface, both the Promotion Mission and Class Promotion Mission were shown to be completed. Han Xiao calmed down and chose to complete the mission.

Level 300 Promotion Mission completed!

+ 70 END! 1 END = 480 Health = 490 Stamina.

Every cell contains a huge amount of energy, causing your body to transform. Your genetic code is transforming toward a higher level. You have taken another step on the path of evolution.

Your race has been detected as [Black Star Race] (Exclusive race, unable to be changed).

Randomly drawing 5 matching evolutionary directions … Drawing … Drawing complete.]

Please select two races from the following five options to obtain a talent respectively.

1. [Void God's Envoy (Human Form)]

2. [Endless Multiplication Mutant (Group Consciousness)]

3. [Void Grand Priest] (Human Form)

4. [Saint Tyracles].

5. [Margala Void Behemoth]

"It's a good direction." Han Xiao raised his eyebrows and nodded.

Previously, he had become a [Void Saint], and now that he had become a [Void Angel], he was getting closer and closer to the end of the evolution of the Void System.

[Endless Multiplication Mutant] was a terrifying creature. It could multiply its own flesh and blood cells endlessly through energy. As long as there was enough energy, it could expand endlessly without worrying about its genes collapsing and eventually turning into a planet of flesh and blood.

At the same time, he could control the formed flesh and blood structure. For example, he could form a new type of monster with normal life cycle ability, create a flesh and blood brain for it, and then split it from his own body. This way, he could create a new type of mutated monster that was controlled by his main consciousness but had its own consciousness.

[Saint Tyracles] was an extinct race with excellent mechanical talents. Legend had it that they were natural-born Mechanics.

[Margala Void Behemoth] was a void monster with an extremely strong body, similar to the Leviathan of the Void System. It was as famous as the Void Dragon race, but it was even rarer.

After thinking for a while, Han Xiao made his decision. He chose [Void Angel] and [Saint Tyracles]. The former was to maintain the evolution of the Void System, and the latter was to choose a talent that could increase the abilities of a Mechanic.

He now had quite a lot of Void talents. The reason why he did not choose [Void Grand Priest] was because it overlapped with many of the talents of [Void Angel]. Although [Endless Multiplication Mutant] was terrifying, Han Xiao was not prepared to give up on his human form.

He still had to be human.

[Margala Void Behemoth] was famous for being a tank. It was not that Han Xiao was arrogant, but he felt that he was already a top-notch tank in this aspect, and there was no need to increase his ability to take a beating.

All the talents of the two races were displayed before him, and he could choose one of them. Han Xiao looked at it for a while and made his choice.

You have received a new talent [Void God Power]!

You have received a new talent [Tyracles Mechanical Legacy]!

[Void God Power]: Your understanding of the Void Dimension has reached a whole new level. You can control the Void Energy in a more efficient way, cleanse yourself, and increase your attributes in all aspects.

Current Total Enhancement: + 900 STR, + 30% Ability Power.

[Tyracles Mechanical Legacy]: The experience of Mechanics is the inherited memory of the Saint Tyracles race. The Saint Tyracles race has excellent talent in the Mechanic class. The cost of leveling up any Mechanic class skill will be reduced by 20% (including but not limited to Mechanic class skills, blueprint skills, and so on).

The inherited memory of the Saint Tyracles race records their unique technological achievements. When the total level reaches LV20, LV60, LV100, LV160, LV200, LV260, LV320, and LV360, special race blueprints will be unlocked.

Boom!

His brain was spinning rapidly, and the Void Energy kept washing his body. It was as if he had been attacked by ice and fire at the same time, cold and hot.

Your Black Star race talent [Mechanical Genius] has been improved.

[Mechanical Genius]: Total Machinery Affinity has increased from 1.15x to 1.25x. Mechanical Creation Performance bonus has increased from 30% to 40%. All Mechanic class skills will be increased by one level.

Your life has been improved. Your molecular structure has been improved. Your organ structure has been strengthened. Your metabolism has been changed …

The potential of the Black Star Race has been increased. You have received bonus stats: + 334 STR, + 320 DEX, + 470 END, + 767 INT, + 580 MYS, + 205 CHA, + 8000 Energy. Energy Realm bonus stats have been changed.

Every single cell in his body was vibrating, pumping out waves of energy. The tremendous waves they emitted directly affected the entire planet's environment. It was as if his entire body had become the eye of the storm. With him as the center, the planet's atmosphere formed the eye of the storm.

In the fleet in outer space, Aurora, Fu Ding, Hardaway, and all the Black Star Guards were standing in front of the observation window, observing the environmental changes Han Xiao was causing on the planet.

"What a terrifying high-energy reaction. Has His Excellency Black Star grown yet again? At his level, he can still increase his strength in such a short time?! "Hardaway was shocked.

"Although I've known him for a long time, he never fails to amaze me." Fu Ding shook his head. "How can there be such a talented person in this world? He's practically a natural-born Super."

"I've never heard of a Beyond Grade A who grows so quickly." Hardaway's tone was both shocked and jealous.

He had fought for a long time to become a Beyond Grade A, but he had yet to achieve his wish. On the other hand, Black Star was not only the fastest person in history to reach Beyond Grade A from zero, but he was also able to maintain a rapid growth in strength after entering Beyond Grade A. This was simply unheard of.

Comparisons are odious … Hadavy had a look of envy and jealousy on his face.

Not only him, but the other Black Star Guards were also shocked. Such a growth speed was simply unimaginable.

Aurora clenched her fists nervously. Her palms were sweaty.

This was the first time she had witnessed Han Xiao's Promotion process after her Esper Ability was formed. In her perception, Black Star's life force soared like a rocket, completely different from the common sense of Beyond Grade A. She could not help but be on tenterhooks, afraid that Han Xiao's Promotion would fail.

She was even prepared to consume ninety-nine percent of her life force to help Han Xiao.

After a long time, the high-energy reaction gradually decreased.

"Looks like it succeeded."

Just as everyone was about to heave a sigh of relief, they were shocked to find that the high-energy reaction that had just decreased suddenly soared again, instantly breaking through the previous highest level. It rose and fell like their blood pressure!

A new storm appeared again!

"He just completed his Promotion, and now it's happening again?"

Everyone was dumbfounded. They felt as if their worldview had been shattered.

At this time, Han Xiao, who was in the center of the planetary storm, had already confirmed his Class Advancement on the interface!

Your Class Advancement mission has been completed!

You have received a new Class (Divine Throne Mechanic)!
